name: lean-cyclic
cmd: export LEAN_PATH=$PWD:$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(elan which lean))))/lib/lean; { [ -f Cert.olean ] || lean -o Cert.olean Cert.lean; } && { [ -f Kernel.olean ] || lean -o Kernel.olean Kernel.lean; } && lean -o Cyclic.olean Cyclic.lean 2>&1 | tail -40; s=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo lean-exit $s; exit $s
